home.gapTitle: Nobody was going to make this
home.gapBody: Walk into any sporting goods store in Canada and you'll find hockey, basketball, soccer, running, and a wall of gym wear. You won't find handball. Not a shirt, not a hoodie, not a sticker. The sport is played here — in school gyms, on beaches, at clubs holding on with volunteers — and none of it is visible. So we specified it ourselves.

fund.title: 10% back into Canadian handball
fund.basisMerch: 10% of gross revenue from every order placed here.
fund.basisAll: 10% of gross revenue across everything we sell.
fund.whyBody: Handball in Canada does not lose players because the sport is hard to like. It loses them because a club can't find a goal to buy, a school can't source twelve size-2 balls, and a beach programme can't get boundary lines across the border. Money is the bottleneck at exactly the moment a programme is most fragile — and a shirt is a strange but honest way to move some.
fund.howBody: Equipment grants to clubs, schools and beach programmes — the goals, balls and nets they otherwise go without. Applications open once the first drop sells through.
fund.transparencyBody: We publish what came in, what went out and who received it, every quarter, on this page. A donation promise you can't audit is just marketing.
